name: usda-mcp-server
description: Search foods, compare nutrients, and look up the full USDA FoodData Central database via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search foods, compare nutrients, and look up the full USDA FoodData Central database via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Five tools over USDA FoodData Central: search foods across the Foundation, SR Legacy, Survey, and Branded datasets, fetch one food or a batch by FDC ID, compare nutrient profiles across foods side by side, and list the nutrient vocabulary. Requires a free api.data.gov API key.
